mapper.select: SELECT '业务概览' as report_title, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') as report_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as total_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as total_departments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE status = 'RUNNING') as active_projects, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(base_salary), 2) FROM employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as avg_salary, (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as monthly_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as monthly_orders

SELECT report_period.period_name, report_period.start_date, report_period.end_date,
-- 收入统计 IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue, IFNULL(order_income.order_count, 0) as order_count, IFNULL(order_income.avg_order_value, 0) as avg_order_value,
-- 成本统计 IFNULL(salary_costs.total_salary_cost, 0) as total_salary_cost, IFNULL(salary_costs.employee_count, 0) as payroll_employee_count, IFNULL(project_costs.total_project_cost, 0) as total_project_cost, IFNULL(project_costs.project_count, 0) as active_project_count,
-- 利润计算 (IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) - IFNULL(salary_costs.total_salary_cost, 0) - IFNULL(project_costs.total_project_cost, 0)) as gross_profit,
-- 利润率计算 CASE WHEN IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(((IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) - IFNULL(salary_costs.total_salary_cost, 0) - IFNULL(project_costs.total_project_cost, 0)) / IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as profit_margin_percentage,
-- 成本占比 CASE WHEN IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND((IFNULL(salary_costs.total_salary_cost, 0) / IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as salary_cost_ratio,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND((IFNULL(project_costs.total_project_cost, 0) / IFNULL(order_income.total_revenue, 0)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as project_cost_ratio
FROM (SELECT #{periodName} as period_name, #{startDate} as start_date, #{endDate} as end_date) report_period LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(final_amount) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as order_count, AVG(final_amount) as avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')) order_income ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(net_salary) as total_salary_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) as employee_count FROM salary WHERE pay_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status = 'PAID') salary_costs ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(budget) as total_project_cost, COUNT(*) as project_count FROM project WHERE start_date <= #{endDate} AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{startDate}) AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED')) project_costs ON 1 = 1

SELECT analysis_dimension.dimension_type, analysis_dimension.dimension_value, analysis_dimension.dimension_label,
-- 订单统计 COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, SUM(o.final_amount) as total_sales, AVG(o.final_amount) as avg_order_value, MAX(o.final_amount) as max_order_value, MIN(o.final_amount) as min_order_value,
-- 客户统计 COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_phone) as unique_customers,
-- 产品统计 SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_sku) as unique_products,
-- 支付方式分布 COUNT(CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'CREDIT_CARD' THEN 1 END) as credit_card_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'ALIPAY' THEN 1 END) as alipay_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'WECHAT_PAY' THEN 1 END) as wechat_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'BANK_TRANSFER' THEN 1 END) as bank_transfer_orders,
-- 订单状态分布 COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pending_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 END) as processing_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 END) as shipped_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END) as delivered_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders,
-- 转化率计算 ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.order_id)), 2) as delivery_rate, ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status != 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.order_id)), 2) as success_rate
FROM (
SELECT 'DAILY' as dimension_type, DATE(order_date) as dimension_value, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as dimension_label FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(order_date)
SELECT 'MONTHLY' as dimension_type, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') as dimension_value, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y年%m月') as dimension_label FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')
SELECT 'PAYMENT_METHOD' as dimension_type, payment_method as dimension_value, payment_method as dimension_label FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY payment_method
SELECT 'CUSTOMER_LEVEL' as dimension_type, customer_level as dimension_value, customer_level as dimension_label FROM ( SELECT customer_phone, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'VIP' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 5 THEN 'GOLD' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN 'SILVER' ELSE 'BRONZE' END as customer_level FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_phone ) customer_levels GROUP BY customer_level
SELECT 'ALL' as dimension_type, 'ALL' as dimension_value, '全部' as dimension_label
) analysis_dimension LEFT JOIN orders o ON (
DATE(o.order_date) = analysis_dimension.dimension_value
DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') = analysis_dimension.dimension_value
o.payment_method = analysis_dimension.dimension_value
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT customer_phone, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 THEN 'VIP' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 5 THEN 'GOLD' WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN 'SILVER' ELSE 'BRONZE' END as customer_level FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_phone ) cl WHERE cl.customer_phone = o.customer_phone AND cl.customer_level = analysis_dimension.dimension_value )
1=1
AND o.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY analysis_dimension.dimension_type, analysis_dimension.dimension_value, analysis_dimension.dimension_label ORDER BY analysis_dimension.dimension_value

SELECT 'DATABASE_STATISTICS' as report_type, 'SYSTEM' as report_category,
-- 数据表统计 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee) as total_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department) as total_departments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project) as total_projects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) as total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salary) as total_salary_records,
-- 数据增长趋势（最近30天） (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE created_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as new_employees_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE created_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as new_projects_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) as new_orders_30d,
-- 状态分布 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as active_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as active_projects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('CANCELLED')) as valid_orders,
-- 系统负载指标 (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(description)) FROM project WHERE description IS NOT NULL) as avg_project_desc_length, (SELECT MAX(final_amount) FROM orders) as max_order_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_phone) FROM orders) as unique_customers,
-- 数据质量指标 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE email IS NULL OR email = '') as employees_missing_email, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE description IS NULL OR description = '') as projects_missing_desc, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE tracking_number IS NULL OR tracking_number = '') as orders_missing_tracking,
-- 报表生成时间 NOW() as report_generated_time, CURDATE() as report_date
